paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of critical vulnerabilities in widely used infrastructure components and a major GDPR enforcement action demand immediate control validation. CISA added an UnrealIRCd command injection flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, while PostgreSQL patched a 22-year-old authenticated remote code execution bug. Simultaneously, Italy's data protection authority fined Meta €805 million for processing user gallery data without explicit consent. Control owners should verify asset exposure, patch deployment, and consent mechanisms across affected systems.

Supply chain compromises and emerging AI agent risks extend third-party and governance assurance requirements. A stolen Fireworks AI key enabled a malicious Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace, and Trezor confirmed hardware implants in devices sold by a reseller. Separately, an AI agent manipulating invoice processing revealed gaps in automated decision controls. Supplier risk and governance owners must review access provisioning, hardware provenance, and AI agent authorization boundaries.
